Mosslight / 苔光跃迁 — version 2.4.0

Project code and original contributions
Original game code, project-authored Blender models, the model generator,
procedural geometry and original synthesized audio are distributed under the
MIT License in LICENSE. Project-authored asset contributions and generated
scenery textures are offered under the same terms to the extent that the
project can license them. This does not license third-party character designs,
brands, trademarks or other rights in supplied references.

Generated images and character references
The 3D texture atlas dist/assets/world-atlas.png was generated with ImageGen;
its recorded prompt is in ASSETS.txt.
The 2D forest, city, palace and laboratory backgrounds were generated with
built-in ImageGen. The two ordinary character animation atlases were generated
and edited with built-in ImageGen using reference images supplied by the user.
Prompts and editing records are in dist/2d/assets/PROMPTS.json.
The new fourth-chapter background is dist/2d/assets/lab.png; its separate
ImageGen record is dist/2d/assets/LAB-PROMPT.json.

The white/lilac dragon-girl fan character is displayed as
"GPT （同人Q版形象）" and retains the internal ID "dragon".
The orange pixel creature is displayed as "Claude".
These are game adaptations of user-supplied references, not a claim of
ownership of the underlying character designs or brand identities.
This is an independent fan game, not an official OpenAI or Anthropic product;
no endorsement or affiliation is claimed. Character and brand rights remain
with their respective owners. Generating or editing an image does not itself
clear third-party rights depicted in that image.

The SVG is a sourced third-party graphic, not an ImageGen output. Runtime
color, glow, rotation, surrounding needles and 3D geometry are applied by the
game. CC0 concerns the distributed graphic file; it does not grant trademark
or brand rights. OpenAI's name, logo and related brand rights remain with
OpenAI. The project's MIT license does not supersede those rights or imply
OpenAI approval of the game or the logo character.

Three.js r169, GLTFLoader, SVGLoader and BufferGeometryUtils
Copyright 2010-2024 Three.js Authors
License: MIT
Full license: dist/vendor/LICENSE.txt
Project: https://threejs.org/
SVGLoader: dist/vendor/loaders/SVGLoader.js
The 3D logo character uses SVGLoader to construct geometry from the sourced
SVG. Third- and fourth-chapter 3D scenery also uses project-authored Three.js
geometry and materials.

Authoring tools, fonts and audio
Blender is used only to author and export assets and is not bundled.
No external audio recordings or proprietary fonts are included.
Music and sound effects are synthesized with WebAudio. UI fonts are selected
from fonts installed on the visitor's system.
